PES, or Problem, Etiology, Signs/Symptoms 
Statements PES is the organizational structure or format
in which the nutrition diagnosis is written: “[Problem] related
to [etiology] as evidenced by [signs/symptoms].” Chapters 2, 3,
4, and 5 explain the process by which a nutrition diagnosis is
determined; the PES statement is simply the manner in which
the nutrition diagnosis is documented.1, 2, 7
